description: This Dart source file defines the AppEnv class responsible for loading and accessing environment variables from a '.env' file within a Flutter application. It provides static methods and properties to determine configuration settings such as API base URL and feature flags related to local database usage.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class for loading environment variables from a '.env' file and exposing configuration flags used throughout the app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the '.env' file if not already loaded.

methods.name: isRemoteConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the API_BASE_URL is set and the app is configured to use remote API endpoints, considering local override.

methods.name: useLocalDb
methods.description: Determines whether to force local database usage based on environment variable.
